text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've told you all sorts of secrets
about
myself, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Today will be the final one. Revealing
this one
place is going to be the most
embarrassing for
me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want you to know everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen and I are on our way
back to the
academy after a day out
when she suddenly
decides to take me
on a detour to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A public bath?! No. That's far from what
I meant
by "embarrassing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, wipe such vulgar suggestions out
of your
head. The place I'm most
ashamed of is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Skreeee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When I come here, I can't help but
harbor
the most improper desires.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I always end up harboring the most
unacceptable
of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I experience an unbearable
setback, I
come here and find myself
thinking, "I want to fly
somewhere far
away."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But I am a member of the proud Mejiro
family.
The obligation to remain
steadfast and strong has
been deeply
ingrained into me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, every once in a while, I yearn to
live a simple
life beyond the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No, this is the most shameful feeling I have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To be born a Mejiro, and then to want to
throw
that away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's the most reprehensible betrayal
towards my
grandmother, who loves me
so dearly. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This, too, is part of who I am. My
elegance is
mere pretense. A mere bluff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I'm pitifully weak—nothing more
than a
child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to meet the
expectations
you've set for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With that said... are you still willing to
help me
grow?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are you... feeling disappointed? Be
honest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes of yours... I see no trace of
doubt
within them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Of course you wouldn't be

disappointed. That's why I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's why I'm glad I brought you
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I feel so much better now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen smiles happily. A heavy
burden
seems to have been lifted off her
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Still, there is a certain charm in
the idea
of traveling abroad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There are things one can only learn in a
foreign
country. I would still like to go
someday, but not
as a means of escape.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What? You and I?! Well, that sure came
out of
the blue!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But... yes. That would be enjoyable.
We're
batterymates, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So... where would you like to go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
France... Yes, of course, I see your
intent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would like to go there someday and
represent
Japan as an Umamusume. I
shall train even harder
in anticipation of
that day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
New Caledonia... I feel like I've heard of
it. I
suppose that would be an option
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I learn something new every day. Could
you tell
me what you know about the
place?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Th-the Mejiro Kingdom? Are you
half-asleep, or
something? There's no
such thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but it would be amusing if it were
real.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If such a kingdom did exist, I would be Queen, rather than McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us talk about our endless
dreams as
we gaze up at the blue sky
with airplanes soaring
overhead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. I feel as
though I've
gotten closer to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. From now on, I will keep no
secrets. I hope
you will someday share
all of yours with me, as
well.
